claudeCode.spinnerVerbs.markdownDescription: Words the Claude Code panel shows while the model works. Claude Code reads this setting but does not declare it, so no extension may write it until one does; TICK declares it here in order to put its line there. Owned by whoever set it: if the value is not TICK's own, TICK never touches it again.
